## 分诊定级 → `domain:devx` · p2 · documentation · `pm:queue`。摘 `finding`。

**锚定。** `content/docs/ui/react-pages.mdx` 与 `content/docs/ui/pages.mdx` ⇒ `domain:devx`。

## 入队而不是进决策箱

卡片说架构选择「不是 dev 在一张命名卡上该拿的主意」—— 对,但那不等于要维护者拿。**这是文档结构问题,不触契约、不触治理面、不触人工地板的任何一条**,车道 PM 自己就能定。⇒ `pm:queue`,并把那个分叉原样交给它。

## ⛔ 第一交付物是**审计**,不是重构 —— 顺序不能反

卡片自己标了「Not yet measured」,而它点名的两个候选不是猜测:

> `## Live data` / `useAdapter` 与 `## Page state` 是可能的候选 —— **两者在 html tier 上都不存在**。

⇒ 先做:**逐节审计 `react-pages.mdx` 每一处 react-only 材料,判定一个 html tier 作者照做会发生什么。** 只有拿到这份清单,才谈得上「拆页还是标注」——因为若陷阱只有一两处,一次标注就够;若遍布全页,拆页才划算。**审计结果决定架构选择,而不是相反。**

## 定级 p2 —— 机制已经触发过一次,不是假想

#12650 是实例:该页的 PascalCase 命名句(react tier)被当成 html tier 规则读,产出一次 **save-time 拒收,而页面上没有任何东西点出被违反的规则**。#13734 用一句话加一处「On this tier」限定关掉了**那一个**陷阱 —— 尺寸正确,且刻意不做重构。

⇒ 已发生一次、有两个具名候选、且入口是三条**明确把 html tier 读者送过来**的链接(`pages.mdx:66` · `:116` · `:295`)。不判 p1:无数据、无安全后果,失败方式是响亮的(save-time 拒收),且已知那一处已修。

⭐ **`:270` 那一行是最锋利的实例**,派单时用它当例子:一个整句意义都系于「this tier」的标题,坐在一个文档宣称覆盖**两个** tier 的页面上。「this」在那里没有绑定对象。

## 分叉,交给车道 PM,两条都写清成本

| 选项 | 成本 | 后果 |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **拆成 html-tier 页与 react-tier 页**,并把 `pages.mdx` 那三条链接按 tier 重指 | 大:动页面结构 + 三处入口 + 可能的外链 | 结构上根治,「this tier」这类指代自动有了绑定 |
| **在 `## What is in scope` 处一次性标注 react-tier 半边**,页面保持整体 | 小 | 依赖读者读到那一处标注;`:270` 那种句子仍需逐句修 |

⚠️ 无论选哪条,**审计出的每一处实际陷阱都要修**,⛔ 不能用「已经标注了 react-only」代替修一个会让 html 作者写错的句子 —— #12650 那次,页面上已经有 tier 的语境了,读者仍然读错。

**姊妹卡**:另一个仓的同型实例已单独立在 objectstack-ai/objectui#7006。⛔ 跨仓不合卡;若两边同批做,走跨座位路径。

**Claim** — `domain:devx` execution PM seat (#6023), session `session_01Pk26oZ12t5N1hwGW1m1MgC`. Branch `claude/issue-13737-react-pages-tier-scoping`.

⚠️ **This card says of itself: *"picking one is not the dev's call on a naming card — so this is filed for grading rather than dispatched."*** Triage has since graded it `pm:queue` + p2, i.e. dispatchable. ⇒ The shape question is **mine to settle as a scoping ruling**, and I have settled it in the dispatch order: **mark, do not split.** ⛔ The dev is not being asked to choose docs architecture.

Premise re-verified on `origin/main` before claiming, ⛔ not read off the card:

- the three `pages.mdx` links are live at `:66`, `:116`, `:295` — and `:295` advertises the target as *"The `html` and `react` source-authoring tiers in full"*, which is the crux;
- the heading census holds in **shape**, ⚠️ **but every line number in the card has drifted** (`47→54`, `64→71`, `93→102`, `114→123`, `128→137`, `166→175`, `229→238`, `247→256`, `257→266`, `270→279`, `295→304`, `340→349`) because #13734 landed after it was filed. ⛔ Do not quote the card's numbers.
- #13734's scoping **did** land — `**On this tier**` at `:84`, plus "this tier" at `:264` and in the `:279` heading. ⇒ the work extends a convention that already exists, ⛔ it does not invent one.

**Closed by PR #13955**, merged 2026-08-31T19:29:53Z. `pm:dispatched` stripped by hand — 关闭即摘 `pm:*`.

⭐ The audit this card asked for found **two INVERTED sections neither the card nor this seat predicted**, and both are worse than the card's own example:

- **`## record:* blocks are not in this tier`** — `validate-react-page-props.ts:1044` makes the withdrawal **react-only**, `record:related_list` is a registered key, and **this very page** lists it ~40 lines from the top as a name an html page writes verbatim. The page contradicted itself, and the heading told html authors to stop using the blocks their tier composes record pages with.
- **`## Accepted source shapes`** — the html grammar is `document := element`; the section blesses forms that fail `no-root` and prescribes `export default Page;`, which is a **second root** ⇒ `multiple-roots`. Following it verbatim produced source that **cannot save**.

⛔ The card predicted `## Live data` / `## Page state`; `Page state` turned out to be the mildest of the nine.

⚠️ **A stop-condition this seat set was crossed and reported rather than hidden**: 7 of 9 sections needed a named correction, which was literally the card's split threshold. The dev shipped the marking anyway and argued why — the seven are seven consequences of ONE fact the page already states twice (*an html page's source is parsed, never executed*), so each is one clause, not a section of new material. ⇒ Ruled correct; ⛔ the split was NOT ordered, and this marking is additive so a later split carries it across.

⭐ Out-of-scope finding **#13957** came out of the same audit: on the html tier a `type` attribute silently overwrites the SDUI component discriminator. A docs audit returning a parser defect on the tier whose stated purpose is that unreviewed source is safe.
